correction.description: When a pLaw contains more than one <section> element whose section number cannot be extracted (no <num value=...> attribute, e.g. joint-resolution 'Resolved that...' sections and amendatory sections whose body is wrapped in <quotedContent>), assign a sequential intra-law ordinal (1, 2, 3, ...) to the SectionNumber position of the UniqueKey instead of leaving it as '000000000000001' for every such section. correction.description: Teach the extractor's section walker to handle pLaws whose <main> has zero top-level <section> children. Two shapes seen so far: (1) multi-part Acts where <main> contains <part> elements directly (recurse into part/section and emit a row per section, carrying the part heading into the Division columns); (2) short single-section amending Acts where <main> contains <subsection> elements directly (synthesize a single section row per pLaw and walk into the subsections normally). Today these pLaws are silently dropped from the parsed output (0 rows emitted), which is why distinct LawIdentifier counts fall below the public-pLaw count in the XML.
